response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished engineer with relevant IDE development experience (LabWindows/CVI) and architectural thinking, demonstrating strong fundamentals. However, the role requires deep expertise in enterprise Java frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) and Kotlin—areas not evident in his resume. His Java work dates back 8+ years and was mixed with D language development. His recent experience (past 1.5 years) focuses on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack work, not JVM platforms. The specialized nature of enterprise IDE/JVM tooling combined with these skill gaps makes him unsuitable for this mid-senior role despite his overall technical talent.
strengths: Proven IDE development experience (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments) showing understanding of developer tools internals
Strong background designing language ecosystem tooling and frameworks (D libraries, test runners, compiler support) demonstrating relevant domain expertise
Senior-level track record with excellent engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, software craftsmanship, and demonstrated ability to mentor others
concerns: No demonstrated experience with Spring ecosystem, Hibernate, or enterprise Java frameworks—all core job requirements
Java expertise is dated (2014-2018, 8+ years old) and was mixed with other languages; recent 1.5+ years entirely focused on TypeScript/Node.js
Kotlin is not mentioned anywhere; no evidence of deep JVM understanding or modern enterprise framework knowledge

key_factors.factor: Recent technology focus diverges from Java/JVM platforms
Some IDE development and language tooling background
